interface.longDescription: An inactive thin reference-host projection candidate with one task-facing Skill and one bounded lifecycle Hook. The Hook stores only small session-keyed compaction counters under Codex plugin data, never reads prompts or transcripts or executes task-repository code, and remains fail-closed until trusted runtime and profile binding are materialized.
